_comment: Minimal working HBlink4 configuration. Copy to config/config.json and change the passphrase under repeater_configurations.default -- that is the only edit needed to accept your first repeater. Everything omitted here has a built-in default. For blacklists, per-repeater patterns, links to other servers and OpenBridge trunks, see config/config_advanced_sample.json and docs/configuration.md.

global._comment: port_ipv4 is the port repeaters connect to (62031 is the HomeBrew standard -- open it in your firewall, UDP). bind_ipv4 is the local address to listen on; 0.0.0.0 means every interface. Shipped IPv4-only, which is what most repeaters use. IPv6 and dual-stack are fully supported: set disable_ipv6 to false and IPv6 comes up on port_ipv6 alongside IPv4, already set to a separate port here because each address family gets its own socket. See docs/configuration.md for the other layouts, including serving both families on one port.
global._comment_reconnect_report_threshold: When a repeater logs in again, the log shows how long its previous session lasted. Sessions that ran longer than this many seconds are routine (NAT lease expiring, power cycle) and are not reported; shorter ones are, because a repeater reconnecting every few seconds cannot stay online. Set to 0 to report every reconnect. Connections themselves are always logged regardless of this setting.

dashboard._comment: OUTBOUND connection to the dashboard: HBlink4 dials the dashboard and pushes events to it. These settings must match the 'event_receiver' section of dashboard/config.json -- if they disagree the dashboard just shows HBlink4 as disconnected. The defaults here already match the shipped dashboard sample, so leave them alone unless you move the dashboard to another host.

dynamic_talkgroups._comment: Optional local TG command control. Disabled by default. When enabled, a PTT on slot/talkgroup joins or reactivates this hotspot's receive participation; a PTT on disconnect_talkgroup leaves receive for that hotspot only and is not forwarded as a normal call.

repeater_configurations._comment: 'default' applies to every repeater that connects. CHANGE THE PASSPHRASE -- it is the shared secret each repeater must be configured with. slot1_talkgroups/slot2_talkgroups are the talkgroups allowed on each timeslot; list the ones your network uses. To give particular repeaters different rules, add a 'patterns' list -- see config/config_advanced_sample.json.
